cells.reason: The passages contain extensive statements from RJF executives and filings describing how the firm approaches advisor recruiting, so these are facts.

items.text: Raymond James states it would much rather recruit advisors one by one than make an acquisition, because it can then know the advisors are a good cultural fit and 100% of transition assistance paid goes to retention rather than to a seller.
items.quote: we'd much rather recruit one by one, where we know the advisors are a good cultural fit, and 100% of what we pay in transition assistance is going to retention versus the seller

items.text: Raymond James attributes its ability to attract high-quality advisors to its values-based culture, commitment to service, and the unique ways it provides services to advisors.
items.quote: Our ability to attract high quality advisors is based on our values-based culture, our commitment to service, and the unique ways in which we provide services to our financial advisors.

items.text: Raymond James describes its recruiting approach as a 'best-of-both-worlds' value proposition combining an advisor- and client-focused culture with leading technology and solutions, and cites its strong balance sheet and commitment to independence as a differentiator for advisors evaluating alternatives.
items.quote: Our best-of-both-worlds value proposition, where we offer a unique combination of an advisor and client-focused culture coupled with leading technology and solutions, continues to resonate with advisors across all of our affiliation options. Additionally, our strong balance sheet and commitment to independence is proving to be a differentiator

items.text: Raymond James offers multiple affiliation options under the name AdvisorChoice, giving advisors the ability to match their professional goals to an affiliation option (Traditional Employee, Advisor Select, Independent Contractor, Bank & Credit Union, Corporate RIA).
items.quote: Through AdvisorChoice®, you have the ability to match your professional goals to the affiliation option that's right for you, each offering a unique combination of support, freedom and flexibility

items.text: Raymond James states it leads its recruiting with culture and capabilities rather than the highest compensation check, while maintaining competitive economics and disciplined transition assistance.
items.quote: we don't lead with the highest check. We want to have competitive economics. Certainly, we have to have competitive economics, but we lead with culture and capabilities. And so we have a true differentiated value proposition.

items.text: Raymond James describes recruiting as a long-term, consistent process ('a marathon, not a sprint') that requires ongoing investment, and states it targets advisors who want to be at the firm over the long term rather than those moving for the highest check.
items.quote: It's a marathon, not a sprint... You're gonna get the advisors that are moving or not moving for the highest check, and that's not who we're targeting. We have to have a competitive check, but we want the advisors that want to be here over the long term

items.text: Raymond James states it offers loans to prospective financial advisors for recruiting (and retention) purposes, contingent on the individuals joining or continuing their affiliation and meeting conditions in their offer.
items.quote: We offer loans to prospective financial advisors for recruiting and retention purposes... These offers are contingent upon certain events occurring, including the individuals joining us or continuing their affiliation with us and meeting certain other conditions outlined in their offer.

items.text: Raymond James says it is agnostic as to how an advisor affiliates, offering the largest addressable market because it has all affiliation options at scale, and wants advisors to affiliate based on culture, values and platform.
items.quote: we have the largest addressable market in the industry because we have all the affiliation options that an adviser could possibly want. And we have adviser choice where we're agnostic into how you affiliate with Raymond James. We want you to fall in love with our culture, values and the platform and capabilities

items.text: Raymond James states it participates, with limited exceptions, in the Protocol for Broker Recruiting, which governs the client information advisors may take when affiliating with a new firm and their ability to solicit prior-firm clients.
items.quote: We participate, with limited exceptions, in the Protocol for Broker Recruiting (“Protocol”), a voluntary agreement among many firms in the industry that governs, among other things, the client information that financial advisors may take with them when they affiliate with a new firm

items.text: Raymond James states it has invested in transition teams to ensure seamless transitions for newly affiliating advisors while maintaining service levels to existing advisors.
items.quote: we have invested in the transition teams as well, given them more capabilities and capacities to really help with the uptake to ensure that we have seamless transitions of the new advisors

items.text: Raymond James states its recruiting targets advisors seeking a long-term home rather than a three-to-five-year destination, positioning itself as a long-term stable platform.
items.quote: we are looking for advisors who are really looking for a platform and a home for them, their teams, and their clients, where they're not going to have to have another disruption in three-five years

items.text: Raymond James describes its recruiting success as broad-based across affiliation options, with advisors coming from wires, regionals and other independents, and emphasizes decades of experience in each affiliation option.
items.quote: It's not one firm that we're seeing success from. You know, there's a lot of different firms. Advisors are coming from, you know, wires, regionals, other independents... we have the largest addressable market across our affiliation options
